title: Obtainability audit: what is never obtained, in any era
note: Step `--pass obtain` (lib/obtain.mjs). Starts from every world source the pack has today in any era and every recipe of any tier, and lists the items and fluids of the audited namespaces that are never obtained, grouped by material and classified A (give it a source), B (arrives with a later era from docs/journey.md: hide until then) or C (will never arrive: hide it with its recipes). Inherits from steam the recipe types with no machine, the aliases, the tools, the boilers and the steam machines.

world.note: GTM's rubber trees in the Overworld and the sticky resin they drop.
GTM 7.5.3 GTPlacedFeatures/GTBiomeModifiers: marble and red granite patches in the Overworld.
The Moon's ground (gcyr:luna, by hand at the end of HV since v0.5.0): the lunar drill's regolith sample needs regolith and lunar sand (data/grindless/tables/veins_moon.json).
Mars' ground (gcyr:mars, by hand with the tier 2 rocket at the end of EV since v0.6.0); the tripod's stone on Mars.

Venus' ground (gcyr:venus, by hand with the tier 3 rocket in IV since v0.7.0): the pressurized drill's stone, and GCYR's Venusian regolith, a falling surface block (the site casing; B1's hammer also makes it on Venus).
Mercury's ground (gcyr:mercury, by hand with the tier 3 rocket in IV since v0.7.0): the Mercury drill's stone, which any macerator makes Hermean regolith.
GTM's charcoal pile igniter burns logs in the world and leaves brittle charcoal: it isn't a recipe.
GCYR's station packager puts a keycard out with every packed station (SpaceStationPackagerMachine): it isn't a recipe. Shown since S0-3 passed (tables/stations.json enabled).
The facade cover comes from a special recipe (gtceu:crafting_facade_cover) that the analysis doesn't read.
STEAM-X1: the Horizon Collector and its shard are never crafted; the welcome quest The Horizon Collector gives them (EMI info page steam_horizon_collector.json).

UV-F1 registered ytterbium metal (S0-8), but UV-A6 dopes the fibre preform with ytterbium oxide from the EV cascade's Yb strip and nothing reduces the oxide: the metal has no producer; kept registered for saves, future use undecided

UIV-F1 added a dust form to GTM's erbium, but UIV-A1's reductor c8 makes erbium oxide, which lines 16 and 44 use as is (Er:YSO boule, ErCl3 doping), and nothing reduces it: the metal has no producer; added in an unreleased build, future use undecided

UV-F1 registered thorium nitride as a material, but UV-A1 makes the nitride fuel assembly straight from thorium dust, carbon and nitrogen-15 (tables/thorium_fabrication.json, carbothermal nitridation inside the row): the loose material has no producer or consumer
GCYR's Dyson swarm parts stay hidden for good (docs/eras/uhv.md, Dyson swarm): our swarm is our own machines (UHV-B3), so GCYR's satellite, drone hangar and Dyson blocks have no recipe and no use
